result_text:
The per-rep purchase order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders. `SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest` passes (4 tests, 0 failures or errors, including a new one for your Anna/Bob example).

The report comes from `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`. Its subquery had no status filter. I added `AND po.status <> 'CANCELLED'`, the same condition the per-quarter and latest purchase-order queries use, and noted in its doc comment that cancelled orders are not counted. Ordering and zero-count reps are unchanged.

In `src/test/java/com/acme/backoffice/SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest.java`, I added a `cancelledPurchaseOrdersAreNotCounted` test. The `purchaseOrder` helper gained an overload that takes a status. Nothing is committed.
